title: Heart / HSIN

settings_help: ↑/↓ select · ←/→ or enter change · esc close
settings_proxy_master_description: Control whether hsind's local loopback proxy is available. Turning it off also returns every managed client to direct mode.
settings_proxy_master_on_description: Start the local proxy. Client proxy modes are unchanged until enabled with p on the home screen.
settings_proxy_master_off_description: Return all managed clients to direct mode, then stop the local proxy.
settings_import_current_description: Read the current client's configuration. A new Provider is created only when its Base URL or API key differs from every existing Provider.
settings_mode_description: Choose whether this client connects directly to the provider or through hsin's loopback proxy.
settings_language_description: Choose the language used by the CLI and terminal interface.
settings_direct_description: Write the selected provider endpoint and credential helper directly to the client configuration.
settings_proxy_description: Keep a stable loopback endpoint in the client configuration and route requests through hsind.
settings_system_description: Follow the operating system language. Unsupported languages use English (US).
settings_zh_cn_description: Display the interface in Simplified Chinese.
